title: King Lear
desc: King Lear poses the question: What does it mean to be human? Its subtitle could be Being Human. Cruelty, barbarity, savagery, kindness, tenderness, love, in a world that gives not very much back. Set in the fictional present, an aging King invites disaster when he abdicates to his corrupt, toadying daughters, and rejects his loving and honest one.

title: Born To Fly
desc: Two American F-35 Lightning II fighters enter Chinese airspace and cause havoc near the coast. Flying at supersonic speeds, the F-35s create sonic booms that damage an oil refinery and fishing boats. Box office smash hit & multiple award winner Born to Fly comes to life with special operations team headed by elite pilots who face death and challenge the limits of the sky and themselves.

title: Vivarium
desc: A Young couple thinking about buying their perfect single family starter home. They visits a real estate agency where they are received by a strange sales agent and find themselves trapped in a surreal, mysterious, maze-like nightmare.

title: Cold Skin
desc: In 1914, a young man arrives at a remote island near the Antarctic Circle to take the post of weather observer only to find himself trapped in a watchtower besieged by deadly creatures which live in hiding on the island.

title: Butcher's Crossing
desc: Butcher’s Crossing is an epic adventure journey of a team of buffalo hunters that follows a young Harvard drop-out into the Colorado wilderness as he joins a team lead by Miller (Academy Award© winner NICOLAS CAGE) in search of a mythic herd of buffalo in 1874. The journey puts his life and sanity at risk. The adventure will get horrific, confrontation with dark will lead to descent of madness.
